**No.** Don't fight a price war vs $50M. A 40% cut across your base erases $1.2M ARR ($100k/mo), shrinking 18-mo runway to ~6–12 mos (at typical $50k–$200k/mo burn) & destroying new-logo CAC payback. They're burning VC cash to starve you, matching accelerates your death.

**Moves:**
1. **Lock in $3M base:** Target renewals <9 mos out. Trade 10–15% discount or bonus features/seats for immediate 2-yr commits + upfront cash (boosts runway). Exploit switching costs—most customers won't migrate to save 25–40%.
2. **Fence discounts:** Hold list price. Arm sales w/ a stripped-down tier (capped usage, no SLA, annual upfront) deployed *only* in verified head-to-head deals.
3. **Niche & move upmarket:** $50M mandate forces them to chase broad TAM w/ high burn & degraded support. Focus on segments where compliance, vertical workflows, SLAs, & white-glove onboarding matter more than 40% savings.
4. **Counter-position:** Frame their cut to prospects as temporary VC-subsidized bait-and-switch w/ inevitable price hikes + support decay.

**Caveat:** If your product is pure commodity w/ zero switching costs (e.g., drop-in API), price-match *surgically* for threatened existing accounts only, cut OpEx immediately to preserve 18-mo runway, & urgently build workflow lock-in or explore M&A.
